description: How a delivery is going, for the connected person's own order: the stage, minutes remaining, how far the rider is from the drop-off (km), and the rider's first name. Use it to answer 'where is my food' and 'how far is it'. For non-delivery orders it returns the status only. Never shows the rider's phone or exact location.

orderCode.description: The order code returned when the order was placed, e.g. WA-K4M2

restaurantId.description: The venue the order was placed at (needed with orderCode if the person has the same code at two venues)

name: track_order
title: Track an order
